idea: Build a simple local appointment/task planner demo with synthetic data only. Add, list, complete, and filter tasks or appointments locally. No real calendar, no account, no email, no reminders, no customer data, no deployment.
limitations: In-memory only; no real calendar/account/email/reminders/network/deploy; synthetic data only.
not_proven: production readiness, security/compliance, real integrations, customer/market/paid validation.
